name: Nida
summary: Nida is a young human girl living in the lakeside town of Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. Distraught after dropping a cherished gift from her father into the lake, she spends her time crying along the town's docks.

sections.title: A Child's Lost Keepsake
sections.body: Amid the mounting threats of gnoll invasions and Blackrock orc warbands pressing down on Lakeshire, the children of the town still face everyday childhood troubles. Nida accidentally dropped a necklace given to her by her father into the murky waters of Lake Everstill. Terrified that her father will be angry with her, the distraught girl waits by the town pier in tears, hoping someone brave enough will plunge into the lake to retrieve it.

faq.answer: Nida is a young human child residing in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, often found tearfully wandering near the docks.
Nida lost a precious necklace that her father bought for her. It slipped into the waters of Lake Everstill, and she is terrified of her father's anger once he discovers it is missing.

faq.q: Who is trying to help her find the necklace?
faq.answer: Her playmate Shawn notices her distress and asks passing adventurers to dive into Lake Everstill to retrieve the sunken necklace for her.

faq.q: Where is the lost necklace located?
faq.answer: The necklace rests beneath the surface of Lake Everstill, submerged near the town's docks where Nida dropped it.

angles.text: Even as the Redridge Mountains struggle with larger regional crises, helping Nida recovers a small sense of warmth and innocence for the troubled residents of Lakeshire.
